decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - he use hereby permitted for the retailing of farm produce (farmers' market) shall not be carried out outside the following times: 10:00am to 2:00pm on Saturdays.

Condition : 4 - There shall be no access to the site for vehicles or deliveries, and no site
preparation or setting up of stalls or other equipment in associated with the
farmers? market (which is to open only in accordance with condition 3) before
8:00am on Saturdays. There shall be no vehicles, stalls or other equipment
associated with the farmers? market on the site after 3:00pm on the same day.

Condition : 5 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring 12 months
from the date of permission being granted, after which the use shall cease
unless further permission is agreed to in writing by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 6 - All refuse and recyclable material resulting from the approved use shall be
removed from the site by 3:00pm on market day (Saturday). The refuse and
recyclables shall be appropriately disposed of.

Condition : 7 - No amplified music, sound systems or tannoy systems shall be provided or
used on the site in association with the approved use.

Condition : 8 - There shall be a manger on-site for the duration of the markets? operation to
supervise the use.
description: retention of change of use of the school land on Saturdays between 9am and 1pm to the sale of farm produce
